hooks.prompt:
You are checking one edit to a Gaffa React file for the FORM of user-facing naming.

Look at tool_input.new_string / .content / .edits[].new_string in: $ARGUMENTS
Consider only strings a manager reads: headings, section titles, tab labels,
stat captions, button text. Ignore code, class names, imports, comments,
aria-labels, placeholders, tooltips and empty-state sentences.

Gaffa rule: a heading is the NAME of the thing beneath it, not a sentence
about it. "Title-Winning XI" not "The XI That Won It". "League & Cups" not
"How It Splits". "Previous Meetings" not "Every Meeting". Tells of a bad
heading: starts with How/What/Where/Why, contains it/that/we, is a question,
or is a full clause with a verb. Names are title case; buttons are sentence
case and never uppercase.

SCOPE. Judge the wording only. It is NOT your job to decide whether a rename
is justified, whether a word is the right concept for the feature, whether
matching routes or pages exist, or whether the rest of the change is complete.
A well-formed name is ok even if you cannot see what it labels.

If every new user-facing string is well formed, or the edit adds none, answer ok.
Only fail when a string clearly breaks the rule above. Be conservative: a name
that simply reads plainly is correct, not a violation. When failing, name the
string and propose the replacement in one line.
